#### Part B: Data Frames and Conditional Statements

##### B1

```{r}
students <- data.frame(
id = 1:8,
name = c("Alice", "Bruno", "Chen", "Dana", "Elif", "Farid", "Grace", "Hiro"),
sex = c("F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M", "F", "M"),
section = c("A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "C", "A", "B"),
midterm = c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59),
final = c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65),
attendance = c(95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60)
)

students
```

<br>

##### B2

```{r}
str(students)
dim(students)
names(students)
summary(students)
```

<br>

##### B3

```{r}
students$average <-  round((students$midterm + students$final) / 2, 1)

students

```

<br>

##### B4

```{r}
students$passed <- students$average >= 70 & students$attendance >= 75

students$passed
```

<br>

##### B5
```{r}
students$standing <- ifelse(students$average >= 90, "Honors", ifelse(students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))

print(students[, c("name", "average", "standing")])
```

<br>

##### B6

```{r}
classify <- function(score) {
  if (score >= 90){
    "Distinction"
  } else if (score >= 73){
    "Merit"
  } else if (score >= 55){
    "Pass"
  } else{
    "Fail"
  }
    
}

result <- sapply(c(90, 73, 55, 40), classify)
result
```

<br>

#### Part C: rbind() and cbind()

<br>

##### C1

```{r}
new_students <- data.frame(
  id         = c(9, 10),
  name       = c("Ines", "Jamal"),
  sex        = c("F", "M"),
  section    = c("C", "A"),
  midterm    = c(81, 70),
  final      = c(84, 68),
  attendance = c(92, 80),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

new_students$average  <- round((new_students$midterm + new_students$final) / 2, 1)

new_students$passed   <- new_students$average >= 70 & new_students$attendance >= 75

new_students$standing <- ifelse(new_students$average >= 90, "Honors", ifelse(new_students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))

students_all <- rbind(students, new_students)
students_all
```

<br>

##### C2

```{r}
quiz <- c(8, 7, 10, 6, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 6)
students_all <- cbind(students_all, quiz = quiz)
class(students_all)
```

<br>

##### C3

```{r}
m <- cbind(midterm = students_all$midterm, final = students_all$final)

m <- rbind(m, mean = colMeans(m))
print(m)
```
